chapter_mission: Ben Skywalker is formally offered a commission in the Galactic Alliance Guard; Jacen's informal mentorship of Ben tightens on-page.
chapter_turn: The GAG offer crystallizes the book's juvenile-apprentice thematic fork in Ben's life; the offer stands unaccepted and open at chapter's end.

scene_plan.purpose: GAG commission offered to Ben; Cal Omas's signature on the commission papers.
Ben alone with the offer; Jacen drops by — the conversation is unsettlingly brief.

exit_vector: Ben alone at his family apartment window, looking out at Coruscant, the GAG uniform-fitting appointment still open on his datapad.
notes: Ben's arc-challenge phase activates here. The offer is clear; the refusal will come slowly across later chapters.
